reason: The hosted version is an early preview that wants read access to our GitHub, Slack and Drive, and nothing here mentions SOC 2 or a DPA, so I would block it at vendor review. If anything I'd have one engineer kick the tires on the free self-hosted Docker build, and that doesn't put a dollar on the card.
objection: You're asking me to pipe our source code, incident history and private Slack threads into an early-preview cloud with no security paperwork, and on top of that sell finance another per-seat tool.
would_change_my_mind: A SOC 2 Type II report and signed DPA for the managed cloud, or a paid self-hosted tier with support so our data never leaves our infra, priced flat instead of per engineer.
